reason: Lomekwi technology predates currently known Homo sapiens morphology by roughly 3 Myr.
Acheulean technology predates early H. sapiens by >1 Myr.
Secure in-situ fire evidence predates early H. sapiens.
Kathu Pan hafting evidence predates Jebel Irhoud H. sapiens.
Kalambo structural woodworking predates Jebel Irhoud H. sapiens.
Trinil H. erectus engraving predates H. sapiens; symbolic meaning is not required for this falsifier.
Composite weapon evidence predates the continent-scale habitual ochre phase.
Long-distance obsidian procurement predates earliest currently known shell beads.
Large combined wooden construction predates shell bead evidence by >300 kyr.
Kalambo construction predates the current earliest secure fire-making claim; this does not mean fire use/control was absent.
Current earliest secure long-distance procurement evidence is younger, but exchange has severe archaeological visibility limits.
H. erectus engraving capacity existed hundreds of kyr before later open-ended human cultural systems; presence alone is not sufficient.
Fire use existed vastly earlier than the later explosion of cross-domain cumulative cultural complexity.
Stone tool production persisted for millions of years without evidence of human-like open-ended cultural expansion.
